description: This file serves as the server-side rendering (SSR) entry point for a Qwik application. It imports necessary functions from Qwik's server package, a client manifest, and a root component, then defines and exports a default function that renders the app to a stream with specific options.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Exported default function that performs server-side rendering of the Root component, returning a stream with specified options.
